topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and outlines the intended learning outcomes regarding cancer therapies.

topics.label: Conventional cancer therapies and cytotoxic chemotherapy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss conventional cancer treatment modalities alongside the systemic toxicities and resistance mechanisms associated with cytotoxic chemotherapy.

topics.label: Targeting cancer cell vulnerabilities and genetic defects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine therapeutic strategies that exploit intrinsic vulnerabilities of cancer cells, including hormone dependence, checkpoint deficiencies, and impaired DNA repair.

topics.label: Small-molecule kinase inhibitors and oncogene targeting
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics focus on targeting oncogenic driver mutations using small-molecule kinase inhibitors and the mechanisms by which tumors develop resistance and drug addiction.

topics.label: Therapeutic monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the design, mechanisms, and clinical applications of targeted monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates.

topics.label: Cancer immunotherapy and immune system exploitation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the biological basis and therapeutic modalities of cancer immunotherapy, including immune checkpoint blockade and cell-based interventions.

topics.label: Challenges, historical progress, and future directions in cancer management
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics review overarching challenges, long-term survival trends, and future paradigms in cancer treatment and clinical decision-making.
